versions.changelog: Fix: SKILL.md frontmatter version had drifted (stuck at 0.2.0 while the registry advanced to 0.2.4); frontmatter now matches the registry version and will be bumped with every release. No behavioral change.
Clarity patch: the scoring-rubric heading now names the job it serves (job 7 — joke doctor & scorer) instead of a bare cross-reference. No behavioral change.

Language-separation sweep: English sections are now purely English with no interleaved Chinese; each file opens with a one-line bilingual pointer to its Chinese section. Docs only; no behavioral change.

Metadata/docs patch: release now carries GitHub source provenance (repo/ref/commit), and README gains an explicit Feedback & issues section — report bugs at github.com/KimmyPlusLi/HumorUp/issues. No change to the skill itself.
Docs-only patch: README.md is now fully bilingual — complete English version first, complete 中文版 second. No change to the skill itself.

Bilingual transparency restructure: English craft first, self-contained 中文指南/中文部分 at the end of SKILL.md and patterns.md — no more interleaved languages. Five laws now in full Chinese; Chinese-only patterns (谐音梗, 歇后语, 对仗泄气) get their own section. No behavioral change to jobs, laws, or scoring.
Initial release: bilingual comedy-writing skill — punch-ups, occasion messages, original jokes, joke scoring; anti-cringe by design.
